name: Kaharamamm
description: A red-stone mountain city of snow-cream stalls and hero statues, and the small boy who remembers what its silent bell is for.
artStyle: Painterly fantasy concept art, cool mountain light and warm copper lantern glow, soft brush strokes, storybook warmth

book.title: Kerem and the Hero's Bell
book.author: Ahmet Kadir Zengin
book.dedication: For everyone who ran to warn someone, and was not believed the first time.
book.epigraph: Heroes are only people who happened to be there, and did not run.
